model.note: Partial calibration only: n, ed0, ec0, ei0 fixed to the existing literature transfer set; their source information is additional prior knowledge, not data learned by this pilot.
model.bounds_status: exploratory analyst choices within current implementation bounds; sensitivity not established

baseline_source.locator: Table 3, Hypoplasticity row; hs reported in kPa converted to Pa, phi in degrees converted to radians

objective.aggregation: equal channel MSE within test, equal tests

optimizer.selection: lowest calibration objective across all seeds; no evaluation access

calibration_loading: unchanged archived monotonic drained ramp to last monotonic measured coordinate <=2%; duplicates collapsed last, decreasing coordinate rejects
calibration_metric: unchanged archived uniform101axial-strain point squared-error average, not the new evaluation linear-residual integral

initialization.file_initial: exact normalized-file effective stress/e0 for all three tests; archived transient-state policy unchanged

original_table_disputed_e0.all_other_inputs: unchanged file_initial including all effective stresses; hybrid sensitivity assumption only

control_gate: every calibration row, parameter candidate, completion, objective and test metric must equal archived same-seed trace numerically after removing elapsed_seconds only; retain failure and stop later fits if mismatch
native_outcomes: finite unique-key JSON and exact catalogue required; valid constitutive failures/nonzero exit or timeout become failed test, candidate objective1e30 as archived; retain all three test attempts; malformed JSON/launch/catalogue failure aborts workflow rather than inventing a constitutive score
selection: lowest calibration objective among successful starts within each scenario; ties retain listed seed order; no evaluation responses are loaded for fitting or selection
limits: Same partial-fit prior information and exploratory bounds as the historical study; no common-information or universal ranking claim.
An original-table alternative is not a source correction, probabilistic uncertainty model or full published nominal initialization.
No evaluation replay here; sensitivity of selected evaluation outcomes requires a separate frozen continuation.
This protocol fixes a development numerical comparison, not blind evaluation or scientific admission.
No source changes, model migration, compilation, new data or optimizer expansion.
